summary: Tiziana Life Sciences Ltd, a London-domiciled Nasdaq-listed biotech, furnished a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026 disclosing a clinical milestone rather than any corporate transaction. The press release announced that the first three participants received their initial dose of intranasal foralumab in the Phase 2a Healey ALS MyMatch BANYAN trial, a 44-patient, 3:1 randomized, placebo-controlled study with a 12-week controlled period plus 12-week active extension, co-funded by the ALS Association and sponsored by the company. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are implicated, so no special-situation classification applies.
